metaDescription: Order custom bag included jackets for your team. Perfect for safety managers & HR directors. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Bag included jackets combine outerwear with a matching storage bag, making them ideal for safety managers issuing gear to field crews or HR directors distributing uniform layers at company events. The integrated bag keeps the jacket neatly packed when not in use, reducing clutter in trucks and lockers. Choose from popular styles like softshell or fleece, and add your logo via screen printing or embroidery for a professional finish.
